content.body:
This note provides an overview of Zone 7b climate characteristics and general gardening considerations for beginners.

## Climate Details
- **Content**: Zone 7b features average minimum winter temperatures of 5°F to 10°F, with a growing season from mid-April to mid-October (180-200 frost-free days). Beginners should focus on hardy, low-maintenance vegetables and plan around frost dates.
- **Notes**: This serves as foundational knowledge for planning a garden in Zone 7b. Consider cross-referencing local frost dates for precision.

## Area Responsibility
- **Responsibility**: Maintaining knowledge and practices for successful gardening in Zone 7b.
- **Review Frequency**: Every 90 days
